summary: Added dev_supervisor/integrate.py: CLI that evaluates seven merge gates (pr_state, checks, merge_state, scope, review, secrets, forbidden_files) with injected gh/git runners and prints a gate table. Dry run by default; with --yes and all PASS it takes an exclusive O_EXCL lock file in the supervisor state dir, re-evaluates under the lock, merges with gh pr merge --merge --match-head-commit, reads back MERGED, posts one dev-integrate v1 PR comment and appends a supervisor event. Never admin/force; at most one retry after confirming head unchanged. 86 offline tests. A minimal review-marker parser and diff hash live inside integrate.py (PROPOSED: replace with dev_supervisor.review from lane L2). OBSERVED: one live dry run on PR #60 (gate table only). NOT TESTED: a real --yes merge, a real review comment against live GitHub, wave/ PR scope against a real wave PR. Follow-up: registry-only non-wave PRs now PASS the review gate (protocol section 18 gate 4); wave PRs and PRs with any non-registry file still need review. Review fixes (PR #78): structural registry exemption limited to the author's own task/step/agreement records (CHANGELOG append-only); lock hardened (empty/torn fresh lock respected, live holder never stolen, atomic rename takeover, token verify, heartbeat); new gate 8 'reserved' with --lukas-direct-word override recorded; wave scope manifest only from base or the wave's first commit; marker parser and diff hash now imported from dev_supervisor.review (verdict logic kept local: author_association filter, richer author set, any CHANGES_REQUESTED blocks).
